title: Surface-Aware Generative Design of Selective Inhibitors for Protein–Membrane Adsorption
authors: ByungUk Park; Reid C. Van Lehn
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了结合表面几何深度学习（MaSIF-PMP）与扩散生成模型的框架，设计靶向外周膜蛋白界面结合位点的蛋白结合剂，并通过MD和增强采样验证，属于蛋白质结构计算与生成设计的前沿工作。
abstract: Peripheral membrane proteins (PMPs) bind membrane surfaces through interfacial binding sites (IBSs) that are critical for stable membrane association and proper orientation of catalytic active sites. Dysregulated PMP–membrane interactions can enhance catalytic activity and contribute to diseases including cancer, but many PMPs remain difficult therapeutic targets because their active sites lack well-defined pockets or become accessible only upon membrane binding. In this work, we developed a multistage computational framework that integrates MaSIF-PMP, a surface-centered geometric deep learning model for IBS prediction, with a generative diffusion model to design protein binders that target PMP IBSs and inhibit membrane adsorption. Candidate binders were ranked using MaSIF-PMP prediction scores and geometric descriptors, then validated by molecular dynamics and enhanced sampling simulations. Applied to three disease-relevant PMPs, the framework identified selective binders that disrupted membrane association while minimizing off-target membrane interactions, providing a potential strategy for designing PMP membrane-adsorption inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 外周膜蛋白（PMPs）通过界面结合位点（IBSs）与膜表面结合，这些位点对于稳定的膜结合及催化活性位点的正确取向至关重要。PMP-膜相互作用的失调可增强催化活性，并导致包括癌症在内的疾病，但许多PMPs因其活性位点缺乏明确的袋状结构或仅在膜结合后才可及，仍是难以治疗靶点。在本工作中，我们开发了一个多阶段计算框架，该框架整合了MaSIF-PMP（一种用于IBS预测的表面中心几何深度学习模型）与生成扩散模型，以设计靶向PMP IBSs并抑制膜吸附的蛋白结合物。候选结合物通过MaSIF-PMP预测评分和几何描述符进行排序，随后通过分子动力学和增强采样模拟进行验证。应用于三种疾病相关的PMPs时，该框架识别出选择性结合物，这些结合物破坏了膜关联，同时最小化了脱靶膜相互作用，为设计PMP膜吸附抑制剂提供了一种潜在策略。
